in_marathi.name: Amrith
in_marathi.long_meaning: Amrith हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Amritha is the name of the nectar of immortality that the gods consumed, granting them eternal life. It is also associated with the river of the same name.
